title: Can't match cursorSave and cursorRestore
publicBody:
Today I was working with the regex and noticed that [`cursorSave`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/ansi-escapes/blob/main/index.js#L49) and [`cursorRestore` ](https://github.com/sindresorhus/ansi-escapes/blob/main/index.js#L50) don't get stripped with `strip-ansi`.

I didn't check the other use cases yet, but wanted to make sure first that it is correct what I assume here.

It is the case, happy to send a PR.
contractNotes: Cursor save and restore escape sequences must match completely without consuming adjacent text. Exercise ESC s/u and CSI s/u, default global behavior and onlyFirst; retain SGR/plain-text behavior. Public original issue references ansi-escapes; fix PR #45 explicitly closes #36. Upstream test fixtures and the dev-only ansi-escapes package addition are not production patch paths.

title: Unable to match links ended with `\u001B` rather than `\u0007`.
publicBody:
`ansi-regex` cannot match link regexes that end in `\u0001B`, as the regex only allows `\u0007`.

Example: `\x1b]8;;http://example.com/\x1b\\This is a link\x1b]8;;\x1b\\ hello`
Reference: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/53697
contractNotes: OSC8 hyperlink metadata must be matched through valid ST terminators, preserving the visible caption and neighboring text. Cover ESC-backslash (original reproduction), BEL compatibility, and C1 ST as the equivalent documented ANSI string terminator; include parameterized URI metadata and onlyFirst. Fix PR #58 is explicitly linked as closing #56.

title: TypeError when string contains certain Unicode Format characters
contractNotes: Original issue enumerates non-default-ignorable Unicode Format characters and expects zero columns without throwing. Grader checks all 13 listed scalars, mixed visible/format text, Arabic digits and existing plain/CJK/ANSI behaviors. The original issue body includes suggested solutions; retain it exactly as public task input, without adding later solution comments. Requires modern Node with Unicode v regexp support (use Node24).
